item.tib: bstan srung spyi la gtang rag 'bul ba bsam pa myur 'grub bar chod kun sel
item.coloph: ces bon skyong gtang rag 'di ni/ bon po blo sems dkar ba'i sngags 'chang kho bo skal (?)yang yang bskul ngor/ sa gsum 'gran zla bral ba sman ri'i mkhan po dbra btsun shes rab dgongs rgyal gyis bgyis pa'o/ nyes gyur skyabs gnas rnams la bshags/ dge ba 'gro kun don du bsngo//
